scope: Method-level comparison, not a performance ranking. Affiliations reflect the cited paper; current lab context is separately sourced.

papers.name: M₂ · this work
papers.title: On the Same Page: Grasp-Conditioned Planning and Learned Control for Mobile Bimanual Robots
papers.mechanism: Grasp-conditioned geometry and a shared object reference coordinate planning, acquisition and local control.
papers.boundary: No communication-free execution or native-contact doorway transport claim.

papers.name: CHORUS
papers.title: CHORUS: Decentralized Multi-Embodiment Collaboration with One VLA Policy
papers.mechanism: Independent copies use local observations and robot-identifying prompts.
papers.boundary: The couch/doorway is motivation; the evaluated tasks include basket transport, tape measurement and book handover.

papers.name: SAI
papers.title: Robots that Collaborate: Sequential Asymmetric Imitation for Learning Coupled Robot Policies
papers.group: Sydney + Zhejiang University + ZJUT · Zhi and collaborators
papers.training: Single teleoperator; human partner → robot partner; interventions
papers.mechanism: Sequential partner-distribution shifts teach waiting and yielding; local visual history supports reactive control.
papers.boundary: Closest embodiment match; the curriculum differs from M2 shared readiness supervision.

papers.name: decMBC
papers.title: Learning Decentralized Multi-Biped Control for Payload Transport
papers.mechanism: Assigned attachment geometry and desired payload motion condition local control.
papers.boundary: A structural antecedent for M2; rigid attachment avoids learning four-hand acquisition.

papers.name: decPLM
papers.title: Multi-Quadruped Cooperative Object Transport: Learning Decentralized Pinch-Lift-Move
papers.coupling: Frictional pinch contact; no rigid fixture
papers.mechanism: Arm/base hierarchy and contact-constellation rewards coordinate pinch, lift and motion.
papers.boundary: Go2 + D1 hardware uses contact pads; this differs from wheeled bimanual grasping.

papers.name: MIMIC-D
papers.title: MIMIC-D: Multi-modal Imitation for MultI-agent Coordination with Decentralized Diffusion Policies
papers.mechanism: Joint diffusion training preserves alternative coordination modes; each policy executes with local information.
papers.boundary: Kinova3 + xArm7 hardware; not a mobile bimanual transport demonstration.

papers.name: CLAS
papers.title: CLAS: Coordinating Multi-Robot Manipulation with Central Latent Action Spaces
papers.group: Volkswagen ML Research Lab · Aljalbout / Karl / van der Smagt
papers.robot: Two or four fixed robot arms
papers.mechanism: A common latent task policy and agent-specific decoders couple local actions.
papers.boundary: Shared object observations remain; decentralized action generation does not mean no common task information.

papers.name: Collaborative pick-and-place
papers.title: Collaborative Loco-Manipulation for Pick-and-Place Tasks with Dynamic Reward Curriculum
papers.group: ETH Zurich / CRL + RSL · Coros + Hutter
papers.robot: 1–2 ANYmal D robots with single arms
papers.mechanism: The policy encodes object and neighbor state; hardware uses motion capture and gRPC communication.
papers.boundary: Not a communication-free baseline. Its end-to-end pick/place task is broader than M2 native lift.

papers.name: PAINT
papers.title: PAINT: Partner-Agnostic Intent-Aware Cooperative Transport with Legged Robots
papers.group: ETH Zurich / RSL + CRL · Hutter + Coros
papers.mechanism: Proprioceptive history estimates interaction wrench without external force sensing or payload tracking.
papers.boundary: Partner-agnostic interaction contrasts with M2 explicit object state and common reference.

papers.name: Payload-aware trajectory optimization
papers.title: Payload-aware Trajectory Optimisation for Non-holonomic Mobile Multi-robot Manipulation with Tip-Over Avoidance
papers.robot: Two Husky bases with UR5e arms
papers.mechanism: Bilevel optimization couples non-holonomic trajectories to payload-dependent support forces for tip-over avoidance.
papers.boundary: A planning-side counterpart; M2 geometric clearance bound does not certify this load-dependent stability.

papers.name: Layered cooperative locomotion
papers.title: Layered Control for Cooperative Locomotion of Two Quadrupedal Robots: Centralized and Distributed Approaches
papers.group: Virginia Tech + Caltech AMBER · Akbari Hamed + Ames
papers.mechanism: Layered MPC and local control coordinate a coupled team; distributed optimization exchanges predictions.
papers.boundary: A precedent for layered decomposition; communication delay differs from delayed physical acquisition.

papers.name: Cooperative grasp selection
papers.title: Cooperative Grasping for Collective Object Transport in Constrained Environments
papers.robot: Two Dingo-O bases with single arms
papers.coupling: Selected grasps on a shared object
papers.mechanism: A learned embedding supports feasible grasp selection in constrained transport environments.
papers.boundary: Grasp selection is learned; this is not a decentralized learned low-level controller.

papers.name: Semi-coupled hierarchical planning
papers.title: A Novel Semi-Coupled Hierarchical Motion Planning Framework for Cooperative Transportation of Multiple Mobile Manipulators
papers.group: Shanghai Jiao Tong · Zhang and collaborators
papers.mechanism: Global object planning and local redundancy resolution enforce coupled motion through clutter.
papers.boundary: Distributed planning components should not be equated with communication-free policies.

papers.name: CrossFormer
papers.title: Scaling Cross-Embodied Learning: One Policy for Manipulation, Navigation, Locomotion and Aviation
papers.group: UC Berkeley / RAIL · Levine and collaborators
papers.execution: Single policy per embodiment; not team control
papers.robot: Single / dual arms; wheeled, legged, aerial
papers.mechanism: One transformer handles different observation/action spaces and control rates.
papers.boundary: Cross-embodiment scaling is not evidence of concurrent cooperative transport.

papers.name: SimToolReal
papers.title: SimToolReal: An Object-Centric Policy for Zero-Shot Dexterous Tool Manipulation
papers.mechanism: Object-pose goals generalize a policy across tools; human tool trajectories can supply deployment goals.
papers.boundary: Object-centric dexterity is a contact-learning precedent, not a multi-robot coordination mechanism.

papers.name: Play2Perfect
papers.title: Play2Perfect: What Matters in Dexterous Play Pretraining for Precise Assembly?
papers.mechanism: Play pretraining supplies manipulation skills before precise assembly refinement.
papers.boundary: Relevant to staged contact learning; no team load-sharing result.

papers.name: Learning from partner actions
papers.title: Learning from My Partner's Actions: Roles in Decentralized Robot Teams
papers.mechanism: Alternating roles make observed partner actions easier to interpret as information.
papers.boundary: A coordination-signal precedent; not a VLA or learned locomotion system.

papers.name: Haptic communication in dyads
papers.title: The Role of Haptic Communication in Dyadic Collaborative Object Manipulation Tasks
papers.group: TU Munich + Imperial College · Franklin + Faisal
papers.training: Participant practice; no robot policy training
papers.coupling: Ball balancing on a shared board
papers.mechanism: Compares cooperative manipulation with and without haptic feedback.
papers.boundary: Motivates human–robot interfaces but the measured study is human–human.

papers.name: CTDE introduction
papers.title: An Introduction to Centralized Training for Decentralized Execution in Cooperative Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning
papers.training: Central information in training; local execution
papers.mechanism: Defines which information is available during training versus execution.
papers.boundary: An information-access framework, not a transport controller or evidence that shared weights suffice.

papers.name: Mobile ALOHA
papers.title: Mobile ALOHA: Learning Bimanual Mobile Manipulation using Low-Cost Whole-Body Teleoperation
papers.mechanism: Whole-body demonstrations and co-training connect a mobile base with two arms.
papers.boundary: Human-to-robot teaching does not make autonomous deployment human–robot teaming.

papers.name: Human2Sim2Robot
papers.title: Crossing the Human-Robot Embodiment Gap with Sim-to-Real RL using One Human Demonstration
papers.training: One human RGB-D demonstration → simulation RL
papers.mechanism: Extracts task information from human video and learns robot actions in simulation.
papers.boundary: A human-to-robot transfer example; no collaborating robot or human partner at execution.
